notes:
v3.04 — auto theme (ambient light aware):
• Settings → النمط has three pills now: تلقائي / ليلي / نهاري. Default is تلقائي.
• Auto mode follows car.basic.low_beam_light_status: lights on → night, lights off → day. Re-checked every 3-second vehicle tick, so no manual toggling while driving at sunset or into a tunnel.
• Picking ليلي or نهاري pins the mode manually and ignores the lights.
• Low-beam key already proven reliable on H9 Saudi (per CLAUDE notes).
